head: bcb40463120419ffb9e86824078c220db50dbceb
hosted_registrations_note: two accounts on the hosted alpha, both under the owner's answer to RFC-0021 question 4 (no fixed budget): one from the build Mac through service-bridge while diagnosing the phone's TLS failure (defect 4, App Transport Security, fixed in adb56be), one from the physical iPhone with the Release build after that fix. The phone then paired the owner's Android from his QR image and sent one text the hosted server accepted. On 2026-09-14 an unscheduled joint session on the same account exchanged text both ways with his Android — both checks appeared — and carried one call, dialled by him, with video in both directions; that session consumed no further registration. Those results are the contributor's report and are recorded as SHOWN (joint, reported) in stage1-text.md and stage2-voice.md. After the session the phone stopped connecting: its signed read of /v2/messages times out while /health answers in 0.2 s, a server-side condition tracked as issue #38.
note: The files below are the raw output of the runs this branch records. They stay under clients/ios/out/, which is git-ignored, because they carry absolute paths of the build Mac, loopback addresses and, in the screenshots, contact fingerprints and account identifiers. What travels into the repository is this catalogue: path, size, SHA-256 and the time the file was produced. Re-running the command in the README table reproduces the run, not the digest.
